nodes.name: census_tracts
nodes.description: Polygon-based spatial layer representing U.S. Census tracts, Each record corresponds to a single tract area defined by the U.S. Census Bureau. This table supports key-based joins via the 11-digit GEOID and spatial joins with polygon-based layers and point-based layers through its geometry field.

nodes.name: GEOID
nodes.description: 11-digit census tract identifier composed of STATEFP, COUNTYFP, and TRACTCODE. This field serves as the primary join key for connecting tract-level datasets such as NRI, SVI, CRE, and NFIP claims, and county-level datasets such as county and schools.

nodes.name: STATEFP
nodes.description: 2-digit state FIPS code identifying the U.S. state containing the tract. This field is mainly used for filtering or grouping results by state (e.g., restricting queries to Texas, Florida, or Louisiana), but it does not participate in cross-table joins.

nodes.name: COUNTYFP
nodes.description: 3-digit county FIPS code identifying the county within a state. Used primarily for grouping or summarizing results at the county level, rather than for direct joins across tables.

nodes.name: NAME
nodes.description: Human-readable census tract label (e.g., 'Tract 1234.02'). This field provides a descriptive name for reporting or visualization purposes, but is not used for joins or aggregations.

nodes.name: geometry
nodes.description: Polygon geometry representing the spatial boundary of each census tract, stored in OGC:CRS84. This field serves as the spatial join key for overlay operations with polygon layers (floodplain, county, ZCTA) and point layers (hospitals, schools).

nodes.name: claims
nodes.description: Key-based table containing National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) flood claim records. Each record represents a single insurance claim event linked to a census tract. All joins are key-based using the 11-digit GEOID; spatial joins are not applicable.

nodes.name: id
nodes.description: Unique NFIP claim record identifier. Each entry corresponds to a single insurance claim in the dataset.

nodes.name: GEOID
nodes.description: 11-digit census tract GEOID composed of STATEFP, COUNTYFP, and TRACTCODE. Serves as the primary join key for connecting to tract-level datasets such as census_tracts, NRI, SVI, and CRE, and can also be used for county-level aggregations through GEOID prefix joins.

nodes.name: STATEFP
nodes.description: 2-digit state FIPS code identifying the U.S. state where the claim originated. Used for filtering or grouping results by state, but not for cross-table joins.

nodes.name: dateOfLoss
nodes.description: Date of the flood insurance claim loss event, recorded in ISO format (e.g., '2000-10-03T00:00:00'). Indicates when the flood damage occurred.

nodes.name: amountPaidOnBuildingClaim
nodes.description: Insurance payout amount (in USD) for structural building damage. Used in assessing physical exposure and structural loss severity.

nodes.name: amountPaidOnContentsClaim
nodes.description: Insurance payout amount (in USD) for damage to building contents. Represents internal property losses within the insured structure.

nodes.name: amountPaidOnIncreasedCostOfComplianceClaim
nodes.description: Insurance payout amount (in USD) for Increased Cost of Compliance (ICC). Covers expenses related to meeting post-flood elevation, relocation, or reconstruction requirements.

nodes.name: geometry
nodes.description: Point geometry representing the claim location, stored in OGC:CRS84. Although geometry is available, this table is not used for spatial joins; its joins are purely key-based via the 11-digit GEOID.

nodes.name: county
nodes.description: County-level administrative polygon layer representing U.S. counties. Each record corresponds to a single county area within a state. This table supports both key-based joins via the 5-digit GEOID and spatial joins via the geometry field.

nodes.name: GEOID
nodes.description: 5-digit county FIPS code composed of the 2-digit STATEFP and 3-digit COUNTYFP. Serves as the primary join key for county-level aggregations and joins with other tables such as NFIP claims, hospitals, census tracts, NRI, SIV, and CRE. Used in both direct joins and prefix-based joins derived from tract GEOIDs.

nodes.name: STATEFP
nodes.description: 2-digit state FIPS code identifying the U.S. state containing the county. Mainly used for filtering or grouping results by state (e.g., Texas, Florida, or Louisiana), but not for cross-table joins.

nodes.name: COUNTYFP
nodes.description: 3-digit county FIPS code identifying the county within its state. Used primarily for summarization or grouping within a state, but not for key-based joins across tables.

nodes.name: NAME
nodes.description: Official county name (e.g., 'Harris', 'Orleans', 'Palm Beach'). Used as a human-readable label in reporting or visualization outputs, but not as a join key.

nodes.name: geometry
nodes.description: Polygon geometry representing county boundaries, stored in OGC:CRS84. Serves as the spatial join key for overlay operations with polygon layers (floodplain, census tracts, ZCTA) and point layers (hospitals, schools).

nodes.name: cre
nodes.description: Key-based table representing the Community Resilience Estimates (CRE) dataset published by the U.S. Census Bureau. Provides tract-level measures of population resilience to natural hazards, estimating how well communities can withstand and recover from disasters. This dataset contains no geometry field; all joins are key-based via the 11-digit census tract GEOID.

nodes.name: GEOID
nodes.description: 11-digit census tract GEOID composed of STATEFP, COUNTYFP, and TRACT code. Serves as the primary join key linking CRE data to tract-level datasets such as census_tracts, NRI, SVI, and NFIP claims.

nodes.name: GEO_ID
nodes.description: Full Census geographic identifier including a prefix (e.g., '1400000US12001000201'). Provided for reference only and not used in joins.

nodes.name: STATE
nodes.description: Full state name corresponding to the tract. Used as a descriptive field for filtering or reporting.

nodes.name: COUNTY
nodes.description: County name corresponding to the tract. Used as a descriptive attribute, not for joins.

nodes.name: TRACT
nodes.description: 6-digit census tract code within a county. Not unique at the national level; the full GEOID should be used for joins.

nodes.name: NAME
nodes.description: unknown

nodes.name: WATER_TRACT
nodes.description: Flag indicating whether a census tract is composed entirely of water. A value of 1 denotes a tract with no resident population; 0 denotes tracts with land area and population.

nodes.name: POPUNI
nodes.description: Population universe used in tract-level resilience estimation. Represents the total number of individuals included in the CRE modeling population.

nodes.name: PRED0_E
nodes.description: Estimated number of individuals with zero components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: PRED0_M
nodes.description: Margin of error for PRED0_E, representing uncertainty in the estimated number of individuals with zero vulnerability components.

nodes.name: PRED0_PE
nodes.description: Percentage of individuals with zero components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: PRED0_PM
nodes.description: Margin of error (percentage points) for the percentage of individuals with zero components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: PRED12_E
nodes.description: Estimated number of individuals with one or two components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: PRED12_M
nodes.description: Margin of error for PRED12_E, representing uncertainty in the estimated number of individuals with one or two vulnerability components.

nodes.name: PRED12_PE
nodes.description: Percentage of individuals with one or two components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: PRED12_PM
nodes.description: Margin of error (percentage points) for the percentage of individuals with one or two components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: PRED3_E
nodes.description: Estimated number of individuals with three or more components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: PRED3_M
nodes.description: Margin of error for PRED3_E, representing uncertainty in the estimated number of individuals with three or more vulnerability components.

nodes.name: PRED3_PE
nodes.description: Percentage of individuals with three or more components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: PRED3_PM
nodes.description: Margin of error (percentage points) for the percentage of individuals with three or more components of social vulnerability.

nodes.name: floodplain
nodes.description: FEMA Flood Hazard polygon layer representing physical flood risk zones. Each record corresponds to a FEMA-defined flood hazard area. This table is spatial-only and supports spatial joins through its geometry field, but is not used for key-based joins.

nodes.name: GFID
nodes.description: Unique FEMA floodplain polygon identifier. Serves as an internal region identifier within the floodplain dataset, but is not used for joins across tables.

nodes.name: STATEFP
nodes.description: 2-digit state FIPS code identifying the state containing the floodplain polygon. Used mainly for filtering or grouping results by state, but not for cross-table joins.

nodes.name: FLD_ZONE
nodes.description: FEMA Flood Hazard Zone classification (e.g., 'AE', 'VE', 'X', 'AO'). Indicates the level and type of flood risk associated with each polygon. Commonly used for filtering or categorizing flood exposure in spatial analyses.

nodes.name: geometry
nodes.description: Polygon geometry representing FEMA flood hazard boundaries, stored in OGC:CRS84. Serves as the spatial join key for overlay operations with polygon layers (census tracts, ZCTA, county) and point layers (hospitals, schools). Used to determine which geographic regions or facilities fall within flood hazard areas.

nodes.name: hospitals
nodes.description: Point-based layer representing hospital facilities across Texas, Florida, and Louisiana. Each record corresponds to a single healthcare facility. This table supports both spatial joins through coordinates (LON, LAT) and key-based joins with schools via ZIP, with county-level and tract-level datasets via the 5-digit COUNTYFIPS code, Geometry can be constructed dynamically using ST_Point(LON, LAT) in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

nodes.name: HOSPITAL_ID
nodes.description: Unique identifier for each hospital, assigned by the source dataset. Used to uniquely identify individual healthcare facilities.

nodes.name: NAME
nodes.description: Official name of the hospital. Serves as a descriptive label for reporting and visualization.

nodes.name: ADDRESS
nodes.description: Street address of the hospital. Provides location context for reference or display purposes.

nodes.name: CITY
nodes.description: City in which the hospital is located, represented in uppercase. Used as an administrative attribute for filtering or grouping by city.

nodes.name: STATE
nodes.description: Two-letter U.S. state abbreviation (e.g., 'TX', 'FL', 'LA'). Used to identify the state in which the hospital operates.

nodes.name: ZIP
nodes.description: 5-digit postal ZIP code (USPS). Used for filtering or display purposes but not for spatial or key-based joins with ZCTA, since USPS ZIP codes do not align perfectly with Census ZCTA boundaries. ZIP-level relationships should instead be established through spatial joins using hospital coordinates (ST_Point(LON, LAT)) and ZCTA geometry.

nodes.name: COUNTY
nodes.description: Official name of the county where the hospital is located. Used for descriptive or reporting purposes but not for joins.

nodes.name: COUNTYFIPS
nodes.description: 5-digit county FIPS code composed of STATEFP and COUNTYFP, identifying the county associated with each hospital. Serves as the primary key for key-based joins with county-level datasetsand tract-level datasets.

nodes.name: LAT
nodes.description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used with LON to construct spatial points for spatial joins in EPSG:4326.

nodes.name: LON
nodes.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used with LAT to construct geometry for spatial joins in EPSG:4326.

nodes.name: TYPE
nodes.description: Categorical type of hospital (e.g., 'General Acute Care', 'Psychiatric', 'Critical Access', 'Military'). Used for classification or filtering by hospital category.

nodes.name: geometry
nodes.description: Geometry not stored directly; construct via ST_Point(LON, LAT) (EPSG:4326).

nodes.name: STATEFP
nodes.description: 2-digit state FIPS code identifying the U.S. state in which the hospital is located. Used for filtering or aggregation by state, but not for cross-table joins.

nodes.name: UNIQUE_ID
nodes.description: Synthetic unique identifier generated by concatenating STATEFP, 'hospital', and HOSPITAL_ID. Ensures record-level uniqueness across the combined dataset.

nodes.name: nri
nodes.description: Key-based table representing the National Risk Index (NRI) dataset developed by FEMA. Provides tract-level estimates of natural hazard risk across the United States, quantifying expected losses, exposure, and composite risk scores for multiple hazard types, including Coastal Flood (CFLD) and Riverine Flood (RFLD). This dataset contains no geometry field; all joins are key-based via the 11-digit census tract GEOID.

nodes.name: GEOID
nodes.description: 11-digit census tract GEOID composed of STATEFP, COUNTYFP, and TRACT code. Serves as the primary join key linking NRI data to tract-level datasets such as census_tracts, SVI, CRE, and NFIP claims.

nodes.name: STATE
nodes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (e.g., 'TX', 'FL', 'LA'). Used primarily for filtering or summarization by state.

nodes.name: CFLD_EVNTS
nodes.description: Number of observed or modeled coastal flood events within the tract, derived from FEMA NRI event records.

nodes.name: CFLD_AFREQ
nodes.description: Average annual frequency of coastal flood events estimated from historical and modeled data.

nodes.name: CFLD_EXP_AREA
nodes.description: Estimated land area (in square meters) expected to be affected by coastal flooding.

nodes.name: CFLD_EXPB
nodes.description: Expected exposure value of buildings to coastal flooding, expressed in U.S. dollars.

nodes.name: CFLD_EXPP
nodes.description: Expected exposure value of population to coastal flooding, represented as a monetized equivalent.

nodes.name: CFLD_EXPPE
nodes.description: Expected population exposure to coastal flooding, measured as the number of residents affected.

nodes.name: CFLD_EXPT
nodes.description: Expected transportation asset exposure to coastal flooding, representing potential impact on roads and bridges.

nodes.name: CFLD_HLRB
nodes.description: Historical loss ratio for buildings due to coastal flooding, representing the fraction of asset value lost.

nodes.name: CFLD_HLRP
nodes.description: Historical loss ratio for population impacts (e.g., fatalities, injuries) due to coastal flooding.

nodes.name: CFLD_RISKR
nodes.description: Categorical coastal flood risk rating (e.g., Very Low, Relatively Low, Moderate, Relatively High, Very High).

nodes.name: RFLD_EVNTS
nodes.description: Number of observed or modeled riverine flood events within the tract.

nodes.name: RFLD_AFREQ
nodes.description: Average annual frequency of riverine flood events expected per year.

nodes.name: RFLD_EXP_AREA
nodes.description: Expected affected land area due to riverine flooding, measured in square meters.

nodes.name: RFLD_EXPB
nodes.description: Expected exposure value of buildings under riverine flooding scenarios (USD).

nodes.name: RFLD_EXPP
nodes.description: Expected exposure value of population under riverine flooding scenarios, monetized as equivalent value of statistical life.

nodes.name: RFLD_EXPPE
nodes.description: Expected population exposure to riverine flooding, measured as the number of people affected.

nodes.name: RFLD_EXPA
nodes.description: Expected land or area exposure to riverine flooding (square meters).

nodes.name: RFLD_EXPT
nodes.description: Expected transportation infrastructure exposure to riverine flooding, such as roads and bridges.

nodes.name: RFLD_HLRB

nodes.name: RFLD_HLRP

nodes.name: RFLD_RISKS

nodes.name: RFLD_RISKR
nodes.description: Categorical riverine flood risk rating (Very Low, Low, Moderate, High, Very High).

nodes.name: schools
nodes.description: Point-based layer representing school facilities across Texas, Florida, and Louisiana. Each record corresponds to one educational institution, including colleges, private, and public schools. This table supports spatial joins through coordinates (LON, LAT) for point-in-polygon operations with polygon layers. ZIP serves as the primary key for key-based joins with hospitals. Geometry can be constructed dynamically using ST_Point(LON, LAT) in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

nodes.name: SCHOOL_ID
nodes.description: Unique identifier for each school, derived from IPEDS or NCES datasets. Used to uniquely distinguish school records within the dataset.

nodes.name: NAME
nodes.description: Official name of the school. Serves as a descriptive label for reporting and visualization.

nodes.name: ADDRESS
nodes.description: Street address of the school. Provides textual location information for reference or display purposes.

nodes.name: CITY
nodes.description: City in which the school is located, represented in uppercase. Used as an administrative attribute for filtering or grouping by city.

nodes.name: STATE
nodes.description: Two-letter U.S. state abbreviation (e.g., 'TX', 'FL', 'LA'). Used to identify the state associated with each school record.

nodes.name: ZIP
nodes.description: 5-digit postal ZIP code. Serves as the primary key for key-based joins with hospitals and can be used for regional aggregation or filtering.

nodes.name: LAT
nodes.description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used with LON to construct geometry for spatial joins in EPSG:4326 coordinate reference system.

nodes.name: LON
nodes.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used with LAT to construct spatial points for spatial joins in EPSG:4326.

nodes.name: TYPE
nodes.description: Categorical type of school (e.g., 'COLLEGE', 'PRIVATE_SCHOOL', 'PUBLIC_SCHOOL'). Used for classification and filtering by educational institution type.

nodes.name: STATEFP
nodes.description: 2-digit state FIPS code identifying the U.S. state where the school is located. Used for filtering or aggregation by state, but not for cross-table joins.

nodes.name: UNIQUE_ID
nodes.description: Synthetic unique identifier generated by concatenating STATEFP, TYPE, and SCHOOL_ID. Ensures record-level uniqueness across the combined dataset.

nodes.name: svi
nodes.description: Key-based table representing the Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) dataset published by the CDC/ATSDR. Provides tract-level demographic, socioeconomic, housing, and mobility indicators used to measure a community's vulnerability to natural hazards and disasters. This dataset contains no geometry field; all joins are key-based via the 11-digit census tract GEOID. A FIPS field identical to GEOID exists in the source data, but GEOID is used as the canonical key in FloodSQL-Bench.

nodes.name: GEOID
nodes.description: 11-digit census tract GEOID composed of STATEFP, COUNTYFP, and TRACT code. Serves as the primary join key linking SVI to tract-level datasets such as census_tracts, NRI, CRE, and NFIP claims.

nodes.name: zcta
nodes.description: ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA) polygon layer representing U.S. postal ZIP code regions. ZCTAs are spatial constructs derived from census data and are not identical to USPS ZIP codes. This table supports spatial joins via its geometry field but is not used for key-based joins.

nodes.name: GEOID
nodes.description: 5-digit ZCTA identifier that usually corresponds to a USPS ZIP code (e.g., GEOID='77845' represents the area approximating ZIP code 77845). Used for display, filtering, or spatial selection, but not for key-based joins.

nodes.name: STATEFP
nodes.description: 2-digit state FIPS code identifying the state containing this ZCTA polygon. Used mainly for filtering or grouping by state, but not for cross-table joins.

nodes.name: geometry
nodes.description: Polygon geometry representing the ZCTA boundary, stored in OGC:CRS84. Serves as the spatial join key for polygon-based overlays with floodplain, census tracts, and county layers, as well as for point-based spatial joins with hospitals and schools. ZCTA polygons are derived from census tract boundaries and may align or slightly differ along tract edges.

nodes.text: Dùng geometry gốc (EPSG:4326, đơn vị độ). Không ST_Transform, không ép geography, không dùng *_Spheroid, không nhân hệ số đổi đơn vị trừ khi câu hỏi yêu cầu.
Hình học dùng trong phép không gian nên được lọc ST_IsValid().
Bảng điểm (hospitals, schools) dựng hình học bằng ST_Point(LON, LAT).
Join không gian là nhiều-nhiều; đếm thực thể thì dùng COUNT(DISTINCT key) hoặc GROUP BY.
GEOID là VARCHAR, giữ số 0 đầu; không CAST sang số; trong SVI dùng GEOID, không dùng FIPS (BIGINT).
Cột DECIMAL/BIGINT dùng trong SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX nên CAST AS DOUBLE; cột đã là DOUBLE thì không.
Gộp trên cột có thể NULL thì thêm IS NOT NULL; NULL là thiếu dữ liệu, không phải 0.
Tỉ lệ (ratio) trong [0,1]; phần trăm = tỉ lệ × 100.
Nối với ZCTA bằng đa giác, không so khớp mã ZIP dạng chữ.
Nối tract-level với county qua LEFT(GEOID,5) = county.GEOID.
